record.title: Evaluate typed evidence tooling and admit the next bounded improvement
record.intent: Use review and demonstrated gaps to choose the next offline component within the authorized work window.
requirements: Review architecture typing packaging documentation and failure semantics; distinguish actual guarantees from assumptions.
Record the current deadline and results, commit and push conclusions, and choose a bounded successor or checkpoint if no useful work fits.
acceptance: Evidence supports a concrete continuation or a clean handoff.
